title: Spire and Hollow
author: Edmund Hartwell
blurb: Ansel Okonkwo, a thief who steals memories, has spent seven years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
